title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in agent evaluations
summary: Hold: the table says evaluation credit information has no documented automation, but Microsoft now documents a preview CLI command that reports evaluation credit usage. The roadmap facts and spending controls are supported; the allocation call's format and a checklist step without a table row also need minor corrections.

claims.claim: The printed PUT allocationsV2 call, version 2024-10-01 and its body allocate MCSMessages and disable TenantPool for an environment.
claims.quote: All programmatic examples in this article use API version 2024-10-01. ... scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId } ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api.call and the rendered call with "PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01". Add to its note: "The request body identifies scope.environmentId, sets allocatedEntitlements[].entitlementId to MCSMessages and allocation.quantity to the allocation, and sets enforcementRules[].ruleType to TenantPool with enabled false to disable tenant-capacity draw." The operation, version and printed body keys are supported; the standard requires the body in the reference, not in the call.
